## About
Elwood Body Works is a family owned and operated body shop on East McDowell Road in Scottsdale. Whether you want to bring back an older car's original look, touch up the finish on a lease, or get a damaged newer car back to showroom condition, we have repair and pricing options to fit.
We use updated equipment for repair and painting, and we keep it simple: good work isn't cheap, but cheap work isn't good. When you've been in a collision, we want you to get excellent service at a fair price.
We're rated 5 from 174 Google reviews. Reviewers mention Jose by name, along with Ash and the rest of the crew. Stop by or give us a call during the week.

## Services
- Collision repair: We're a PPG Certified collision repair center, handling repair after an accident from bumpers to front end damage.
- Frame repair: Brewco frame racks for trucks and other full frame vehicles, plus a Celette bench for unibody frame repair.
- Finish touch up: Touch up work on the finish of leased vehicles.
- Pick up & delivery: We can pick up your vehicle and deliver it back to you.

## FAQ
Q: Do you charge for estimates?
A: No. Estimates are free.

Q: Do you stand behind your work?
A: Yes. We offer a lifetime workmanship guarantee.

Q: When are you open?
A: We're open Monday through Friday, 8 AM to 5 PM. We're closed weekends and all major holidays.
